text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said on Thursday that it completed the acquisition of Kearns-Tribune Corp for $731 million in stock.
Tele-Communications Inc said in a statement that it issued 47.2 million shares of its series A TCI Group common stock to complete the deal.
Kearns-Tribune owns the Salt Lake Tribune, four regional newspapers, real estate, and interests in TCI Group and its various affiliates.

Tele-Communications said Liberty Media Corp repurchased from TCI Group the 6.7 million Liberty shares that Kearns-Tribune had owned. Liberty paid TCI $168 million in cash as part of its ongoing stock repurchase program, Tele-Communications Inc said.

In a separate deal, Tele-Communications Inc chairman and chief executive John Malone increased his voting power in the company to 25 percent from 20 percent after a series of stock purchases and exchanges.
